title: ChatGPT Meetings companion control protocol v2
description: Authenticated local companion discovery and transport. Recording, uploads, recovery, background synchronization, and cached-data production remain companion-owned.

codexAppVersion.description: Observed Codex desktop application version, never the CLI or Meetings plugin version. Missing or unknown observations must not be sent or clear a prior observation.

MeetingsEligibility.description: Native accepted policy only, independent of audio and recording state. Error may retain a last accepted decision for the same authenticated account. Never performs network I/O when read.

id.description: Exact upstream hosted Calendar event identifier; never replace it with a synthetic or hashed ID.
